title: Item:Silver Flame Nugget
wikitext:
The '''Silver Flame Nugget''' is not a (usable) item, but a quest - of sorts. You are given a Silver Flame Nugget, which you can then upgrade into a progressively more valuable [[necklace]] at the end-quests of the various Litany of the Dead chains parts 1-4, aka Necro 1-4. There are a total of 4 possible upgrades (although most players only do the first 3). 

Each of the Necropolis 1-4 quest chains allows a progressively higher upgrade tier, so you could only upgrade to the [[Silver Flame Amulet]] in [[Litany of the Dead Part 1|Necropolis 1]], etc. However, you can do any lower upgrade at the end of a higher level quest chain. So, if you only want the Level 3 upgrade to a [[Silver Flame Talisman]] (the most popular option, by far), you only need access to the [[Litany of the Dead Part 3|Necropolis 3]] quests - but you'd have to run the end quest 3 times.

== Silver Flame Nugget ==
* This quest requires access to any part of [[The Necropolis]] story arc. Talk to [[Jakob Izakanos]] in the [[Necropolis]] to acquire this quest and the [[Silver Flame Trinket]].
* This is a 4-tier item that needs to be upgraded in certain altars at the end of each quest series.

=== First Upgrade ===
This can be done at [[The Bloody Crypt]] (Necro 1), [[The Shadow Crypt]] (N2), [[The Cursed Crypt]] (N3) or [[Accursed Ascension]] (N4) altars.
* [[Silver Flame Amulet]] - [[Necklace]]: {{Clicky|Negative Energy Absorption|5|1|nocat=1}}

=== Second Upgrade ===
This can be done at [[The Shadow Crypt]] (N2), [[The Cursed Crypt]] (N3) or [[Accursed Ascension]] (N4) altars.
* [[Silver Flame Pendant]] - [[Necklace]]: {{Clicky|Negative Energy Absorption|9|5|nocat=1}}, [[Deathblock]]

=== Third Upgrade ===
This can be done at [[The Cursed Crypt]] (N3) or [[Accursed Ascension]] (N4) altars.
* [[Silver Flame Talisman]] - [[Necklace]]: {{Clicky|Negative Energy Absorption|11|10|nocat=1}}, [[Deathblock]], [[Protection from Evil]]

=== Final Upgrade ===
This can only be done at the [[Accursed Ascension]] (Necro 4) altar. The [[Silver Flame Talisman]] will become a simple gem again. Talk to [[Jakob Izakanos]] to get any one of the following quest completion rewards:

{{:Category:Silver Flame Nugget reward items}}

== Notes ==
* If you have any upgraded version of the [[Silver Flame Nugget]] (amulet, pendant or talisman) in your bags when talking to [[Pok Tranh]] and accepting the [[Emerald Claw Nugget]] from [[Pok Tranh]], the action will delete the [[Silver Flame Nugget]] and replace it with an un-upgraded [[Emerald Claw Nugget]]. You can work around this by storing your upgraded item (amulet, pendant or talisman) in your bank, pick up the [[Silver Flame Nugget]], and then interchange between them by keeping one in the bank at all times. Alternatively, never speak to [[Pok Tranh]], as you will not need a different version of the [[Silver Flame Nugget]] unless you upgrade the Tier 3 version to Tier 4.
